knowledge_base.action: Go to emergency room immediately. Fever in newborns under 3 months is always a medical emergency.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Neonatal immune systems cannot fight infection effectively. Fever may indicate sepsis, meningitis, or serious bacterial infection requiring urgent workup.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: أي حمى في الرضيع أقل من 3 أشهر تستدعي الطوارئ فوراً

knowledge_base.action: Monitor closely. Fever under 38.9°C with no red flags — use age-appropriate paracetamol, keep hydrated. Seek care if any red flags appear or fever persists > 3 days.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Most fevers in this age group are viral and self-limiting, but red flags indicate serious bacterial infection.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: راقبي درجة الحرارة وأعطي الباراسيتامول المناسب للعمر

red_flags: fever with rash that doesn't fade under pressure
knowledge_base.action: Manage at home with paracetamol or ibuprofen (over 6 months). Keep child hydrated. Rest. Seek medical attention if red flags present or fever > 5 days.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Febrile seizures, while scary, are usually benign in this age group but need evaluation. Non-blanching rash may indicate meningococcal disease.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: للأطفال من 1-5 سنوات، الباراسيتامول أو الإيبوبروفين مع كثير من السوائل

knowledge_base.action: Call emergency services (999 UAE / 911 / 112) immediately. Do not wait. Respiratory distress is a medical emergency.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Children decompensate rapidly. Any signs of respiratory distress indicate insufficient oxygenation which can become life-threatening within minutes.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: صعوبة التنفس طارئة طبية - اتصلي بالإسعاف فوراً

knowledge_base.symptom: mild cough / runny nose / cold symptoms
knowledge_base.action: Rest, fluids, saline drops for congestion. Honey for children over 1 year (never under 1). Elevate head slightly for sleep. See doctor if no improvement in 7-10 days or red flags appear.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Upper respiratory infections are most commonly viral and self-limiting. Antibiotics are not indicated. Supportive care is appropriate.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: الزكام عادةً فيروسي يتحسن خلال 7-10 أيام مع الراحة والسوائل

red_flags: purple or red spots that don't fade when pressed with a glass
knowledge_base.action: Emergency. A non-blanching rash with fever may indicate meningococcal septicemia. Call emergency services immediately.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Non-blanching purpuric rash is a hallmark of meningococcal disease which carries high mortality if untreated. Glass test: press a glass on the rash — if it doesn't fade, it's an emergency.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: الطفح الذي لا يختفي عند الضغط مع الحمى = طارئة فورية

knowledge_base.action: Air the area as much as possible. Barrier cream at every change. Frequent diaper changes. If no improvement in 3-4 days or red flags, see doctor (may be candida).
knowledge_base.reasoning: Most diaper rashes are irritant contact dermatitis. Candidal infection (satellite lesions) requires antifungal cream which needs a prescription.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: احمرار منطقة الحفاض: كريم الزنك مع التهوية المتكررة

red_flags: signs of dehydration: no tears, dry mouth, no wet diapers for 6+ hours, sunken eyes, sunken fontanelle in infants
knowledge_base.action: Prioritize rehydration with ORS (oral rehydration solution) in small sips. Continue breastfeeding if applicable. BRAT diet for toddlers when tolerating food. Seek care if dehydration signs appear.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Gastroenteritis is common and usually viral. The danger is dehydration, not the infection itself. ORS is more effective than plain water.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: محلول معالجة الجفاف الفموي (ORS) هو الأهم - رشفات صغيرة ومتكررة

red_flags: crying suddenly stops then resumes (intussusception risk)
knowledge_base.action: Rule of 3s: colic is crying > 3 hours/day, > 3 days/week, for > 3 weeks in an otherwise healthy infant. Try: tummy massage, bicycle legs, white noise, babywearing, eliminating dairy if breastfeeding. It resolves by 3-4 months.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Colic is a diagnosis of exclusion. The mechanism is unclear but it's not harmful to the baby. Parent wellbeing is important — reach out for support.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: المغص يزول عادةً بحلول 3-4 أشهر. قطرات الغاز وتدليك البطن قد تساعد

red_flags: vomiting more than once after injury
baby won't wake or is very drowsy
clear fluid from nose or ear
knowledge_base.action: If any red flags: emergency room immediately. If no red flags: observe for 24 hours. Keep child calm and resting. Wake every 2 hours through the night to check responsiveness. Ice pack for any bump. No pain relief that masks symptoms.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Most childhood head injuries are minor. Red flags indicate intracranial pathology (bleeding, fracture) which requires urgent imaging.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: أي فقدان للوعي أو قيء متكرر بعد السقوط = طارئة فورية

red_flags: fever > 38°C attributed to teething (teething does NOT cause high fever)
diarrhea attributed to teething (coincidental, not causal)
knowledge_base.action: Teething causes mild discomfort, drooling, and low-grade fussiness. Safe remedies: chilled (not frozen) teething rings, silicone teething toys, gentle gum massage. Avoid teething gels with benzocaine (not safe under 2).
knowledge_base.reasoning: Teething is a normal developmental process. Important: teething does NOT cause fever above 38°C. If the child has fever, look for another cause.

products.name: Amber teething necklace — NOT RECOMMENDED (choking hazard)

knowledge_base.arabic_notes: التسنين لا يسبب الحمى العالية. حلقات التسنين المبردة تساعد

red_flags: newborn with eye discharge in first week
knowledge_base.action: Bacterial conjunctivitis needs antibiotic drops (prescription). Viral conjunctivitis is self-limiting. Clean discharge with clean cotton pad (inner to outer corner). Very contagious — wash hands frequently.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Distinguishing bacterial from viral conjunctivitis is difficult without examination. Neonatal conjunctivitis requires same-day evaluation to rule out gonococcal or chlamydial infection.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: العيون الحمراء مع إفرازات: نظافة منتظمة وزيارة الطبيب خلال 24-48 ساعة

knowledge_base.action: Mild hives (no systemic symptoms): antihistamine, monitor. Any signs of anaphylaxis: epinephrine auto-injector if available, call emergency immediately, lie flat with legs elevated. Do not give food or drink.
knowledge_base.reasoning: Anaphylaxis is life-threatening. The window for effective intervention is narrow. Erring on the side of emergency care is correct.
knowledge_base.arabic_notes: أي تورم في الحلق أو صعوبة تنفس بعد أكل = طارئة فورية
